observed_in: Shop and Economy System design analysis

definition: This dimension controls how the prices of items in shops change over time or based on player actions, such as supply and demand, player reputation, or item rarity. Variations can include static prices, fluctuating prices, or prices that change with player progression.
exclusion_criteria: Fixed prices that do not change
Prices that are solely determined by predetermined game logic without player influence
inclusion_criteria: Prices that change based on player actions or inventory levels
Dynamic pricing influenced by in-game events or player reputation
title: Dynamic Price Variation
